description: This file defines the FilterProjectEvent class within the Goteo application, specifically within the Event namespace. The class extends an existing console event class and provides methods to retrieve the current user from the session, set, and get an HTTP response object.

classes.name: FilterProjectEvent
classes.description: A class representing an event related to filtering projects, providing access to user session information and response handling.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current user from the session.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the HTTP response object associated with this event.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Retrieves the HTTP response object associated with this event.
